title: Pointwise exact-couple comparison for representative page differentials
statement: Let C be abelian [def-sp-abelian], and let F be the category of finite filtered cochain complexes [def-sp-filtration]. Suppose boundary inclusions hBZ and isomorphisms eH:Q_1^(p,q)(V) to H^(p+q)(gr^p V) are given for all V, with eH normalized by an epic representative projection z and a graded cycle lift g such that z pi eH=g pi_H [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. Fix U in F, a cohomological spectral sequence E starting at 1 [def-sp-spectral-sequence], and page isomorphisms eZ:E_r^(p,q) to Q_r^(p,q)(U). Suppose representative differentials D(r) [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential] are given and, for every r and pair of bidegrees i,j, d_E(i,j)eZ_j=eZ_i D(r)(i,j). Then the first differential under eZ eH is the connecting homomorphism of the short exact sequence gr^(p+1) U to F^p U/F^(p+2) U to gr^p U, whose arrows satisfy the two quotient projection squares. There exist a type-zero exact couple X [def-sp-exact-couple], eD:X.D(P,Q) isomorphic to H^(P+Q)(F^(-Q)U), and eC:(X.pageCouple(s)).E(2p+q,-p) isomorphic to E_(s+1)^(p,q). Alpha corresponds to filtration inclusion under eD; initialG corresponds to the quotient homology map under eD, eC_0, eZ_1 and eH; and eC intertwines all derived differentials with E's page differentials. All transports and equations are exactly those of the Lean record. This is pointwise in U and asserts no functor or naturality.

proof.text: For the fixed filtered object U form the successive-step short exact sequences. Their homology long exact sequences give a type-zero exact couple X with D(P,Q)=H^(P+Q)(F^(-Q)U), E(P,Q)=H^(P+Q)(gr^(-Q)U), alpha the inclusion, initialG the projection and f the connecting map. Exactness supplies all three exactness and zero-composite conditions.

Iterate derivation. At stage s and reindexed position (2p+q,-p), differentiate representatives to identify the derived E term with Z_(s+1)/B_(s+1). A representative is killed precisely when its differential can be corrected by a current boundary to lie one step deeper; an incoming differential gives precisely the new boundary. The kernel/image quotient comparison gives the induction to the next derived term. At each stage the differential is x to dx, and hence equals D by uniqueness. Compose with eZ inverse; hd yields eC and the differential equation. This uses only the pages and differentials of E, not its successor homology isomorphisms.

At page one cancel the epic composite z followed by the boundary cokernel projection in hH to identify eH with canonical graded homology. The two maps in gr^(p+1) to F^p/F^(p+2) to gr^p are the quotient-induced maps. Their connecting homomorphism differentiates a lifted representative, so equals D_1; transport by hd and eH to get the required first differential. The initially chosen alpha and initialG are already the actual inclusion and quotient maps; their construction gives their displayed equations after index transport.
